shorts_extract.hook: One musical beep AFTER the screen went black solved a 74-year mystery — proving your visual cortex holds a 300-millisecond photograph twice as big as working memory.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Sperling (1960 Psych. Monographs): 4.5-letter Whole Report ceiling vs 9.1-letter Partial Report capacity & 300–500 ms iconic decay curve.
shorts_extract.twist: Why bright flashes bleach iconic memory (and why rapid phone scrolling erases retention), spatial vs category cues, and the Block-vs-Dehaene consciousness debate.
